items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: Tom Malone was playing trumpet and trombone... I get hired and I do the three weeks, and it was the last day of sweeps and on the air David Letterman looks over and he goes, “Paul, the new trumpet player you know, sounds great”

ctx.x: They couldn’t find anybody good, yeah, yeah, yeah.

So then when they moved to CBS I was out on the West Coast playing with Tower of Power and the Robert Cray Band. And I did that for a while. I came back home and I called Shaffer up and I said, “I really don’t want to go on the road anymore,” You know Tom Malone was playing trumpet and trombone. Great trombone player. Trumpet owner. So I was like if you want to add a trumpet full time I won’t go on the road anymore. Took a shot. Called him up. So time went by and I didn’t hear anything, so I get a call from the…
